elements.name: Sun
elements.text: Sun: vitality and warmth, true self-expression radiating confidence into the world.

elements.name: Child among sunflowers
elements.text: The bare child reaching for sunflowers: purity and inner strength, the optimism of a self freely expressed.

elements.name: Sunflowers
elements.text: Sunflowers turned to the light: life that grows toward warmth, fortune and success in full bloom.
